purpose: Teach: 脳死/永続/双方向/包囲/落選/兵力/没収/上告

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、脳死判定の倫理問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the ethics of brain-death determination, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, curious opening. Slight rise at the end like checking in. Patient teacher voice—genuinely interested in the answer, not testing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、永続的な平和構築の論点を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about the frameworks for building lasting peace.
lines.style: Polite, slightly hesitant. Respectful distance in the voice. Careful enunciation. The tone of a student offering his work, not quite sure how it will land.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、双方向のメディア発展史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the history of bidirectional media development in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle, reflective tone. Like she's processing something she noticed—interested but not pushing. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、籠城戦の包囲戦術を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on siege warfare tactics and encirclement strategies.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest delivery. No apology in the voice but aware of the mismatch. Straightforward. Brief. The tone of someone sticking to what he wrote.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 選挙落選議員の動向を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed the movements of defeated election candidates in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Engaged, attentive. Leaning slightly forward in the voice. Professional curiosity—she's genuinely tracking what he's done. Light, encouraging tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近代国家の兵力規模を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my research concentrated on military scale and mobilization in modern nation-states.
lines.style: Earnest, careful. Slight formality in word choice. Steady pacing. The voice of someone defending his focus. Not defensive—just precise and clear.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時没収財産の補償を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper examined compensation for property seized during wartime, correct.
lines.style: Reflective, measured. Gentle rise at the end. Voice carries recognition—like she's seeing a pattern. Not accusatory. Patient, like she's giving space to understand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、上告審の判例研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I studied precedent rulings in final appeal cases.
lines.style: Quiet closure. Respectful, final tone. Slight weariness underneath—aware now. Not defensive, just honest and still earnest. Slight trailing-off, accepting.
